topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecturer, outlines the scope of the cancer lecture series, and sets out the core learning outcomes for the session.

topics.label: Cancer etiology, intrinsic mutations, and epidemiological patterns
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore cancer as an evolutionary genetic disease shaped by intrinsic biological errors, inherited predispositions, and environmental exposures evident in global epidemiological trends.

topics.label: Mechanisms of carcinogens, tumor initiation, and promotion
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how biological, physical, and chemical agents induce neoplastic transformation through direct mutagenesis, xenobiotic metabolic activation, microenvironmental promotion, and host tissue susceptibility.

topics.label: Methodologies for proving carcinogenicity and assessing risk
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the genomic, epidemiological, and experimental testing methods used to establish carcinogenicity and assess human exposure risks.
